instruction.text:
Insert the correct verb in the past perfect simple.

Das past perfect wird benutzt, um eine abgeschlossene Handlung auszudrücken, die zeitlich vor einer anderen Handlung in der Vergangenheit stattgefunden hat. Achte auf die markierten Signalwörter.
instruction.sound: Insert the correct verb in the past perfect simple.

atoms.b: The US healthcare system ((++had_excluded has_been_excluding)) many people <u>before</u> reforms like the Affordable Care Act were introduced.
The USA ((++had_experienced experienced)) several mass shootings <u>before</u> stricter gun laws were discussed more seriously.
Many Americans ((++had_believed have_believed)) in the American Dream <u>before</u> economic inequality became a growing concern.

instruction.text:
Insert the correct verb in the past perfect simple.

Das past perfect wird in der indirekten Rede genutzt, wenn der einleitende Satz im simple past geschrieben wurde.
instruction.sound: Insert the correct verb in the past perfect simple.

atoms.b: <u>The textbook said</u> that the country ((++had_expanded will_have_expanded)) westward long before it became a global power.
<u>The teacher mentioned</u> that industrialization ((++had_transformed was_transforming)) the country by the early 20th century.
<u>The historian said</u> that the USA ((++had_gone ++goes)) through major social changes after the 1960s.

instruction.text:
Fill in the verb, using the past perfect simple.

Das past perfect wird im conditional clause type 3 benutzt, um eine nicht erfüllte Bedingung in der Vergangenheit auszudrücken.
instruction.sound: Fill in the verb, using the past perfect simple.

atoms.b: If the US ((had_addressed)) climate change earlier, it would have avoided some environmental damage.
If the country ((had_invested)) more in education, social inequality would have decreased faster.
If the government ((had_acted)) earlier, the Great Depression would not have lasted so long.

instruction.text: Why is the past perfect used here? Assign.
